source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
You begin the battle holding 3 Flux tokens (tracking them on a dice is recommended). Tokens work as follows:

- You may spend 1 to re-roll an Advance, Hit, Wound or **Damage roll**, a saving throw or a Hazardous test right after it is made for one of your **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH** models or units.
- You can also spend them to boost some Stratagems.
- Each token you spend goes to your opponent.
- While your opponent has 1 or more, they may spend 1 to re-roll an Advance, Hit or **Wound roll** or a saving throw just made for their own model or unit; that token goes to you. Skip this if your opponent's army also uses Fates in Flux.
- In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), you gain 1 if your opponent has any.

With fast dice rolling, after rolling several rolls or saves at once, you may spend any number of your tokens to re-roll up to that many dice.
